end.parentNote: Asha practised the line types using familiar objects and asked Om to explain the direction of each line. Om clearly described standing and slanting lines and later corrected the mix-up between a straight slide edge and a curved line. They were unsure about the sleeping-line example and had trouble seeing one screen label; at home, practise spotting one example of each line type in pictures or around the room.
